notes: Pew pilot: 11 gun-policy items from March 2017 only; standalone Wave 25 survey weights. No Pew trend line until additional years are imported.

entries.title: Gun policy: gun laws
entries.question: Which of the following statements comes closest to your overall view of gun laws in this country?
entries.rationale: Greater firearm restrictions mapped liberal; fewer restrictions conservative. This is a policy-direction convention, not respondent party identification.
entries.question_note: March 2017 only. Wording summarized; standalone Wave 25 weight. Strong/somewhat responses use evenly spaced scores.

expected_labels.1: Gun laws should be MORE strict than they are today
expected_labels.3: Gun laws should be LESS strict than they are today
